TELEMETRY_RESPONSE.meaning: the ESC-reported rotor speed per unit commanded thrust of motor m, against the other motors, changed after the event (DEGRADED: ESC_TELEMETRY_DEFICIT or ESC_TELEMETRY_EXCESS) or not (NOMINAL). NOMINAL is only claimed when the BEFORE window is itself a valid reference. Context: no symptom reads it (finding SB-1)

configuration_assumptions: rotor-to-rotor telemetry level within a factor of 2 in q (declared, not calibrated)
expected_inputs: a PX4 ULog with the stock topics (stock_log.py)
fault_behavior: a statistic that cannot be computed is UNAVAILABLE (INPUTS_MISSING), never NOMINAL; a BEFORE window whose level disagrees grossly with the other rotors (q outside [1/2, 2]) is no reference: UNAVAILABLE (TELEMETRY_BASELINE_INCONSISTENT)
validity_rule: the EARLY and AFTER windows, compared with a BEFORE window whose telemetry level is consistent with the other rotors
